detections.sql:
SELECT u.full_name 
FROM users u 
JOIN login_events le1 ON u.user_id = le1.user_id 
JOIN login_events le2 ON u.user_id = le2.user_id 
JOIN transactions t ON u.user_id = t.user_id 
WHERE UPPER(le1.device_type) != UPPER(le2.device_type) 
AND UPPER(le1.user_agent) != UPPER(le2.user_agent) 
AND le1.created_at BETWEEN le2.created_at AND date('now', '-30 minutes') 
AND UPPER(t.instrument) LIKE '%STOCK%' 
AND UPPER(u.risk_level) IN ('LOW', 'MEDIUM') 
GROUP BY u.full_name 
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT le1.device_type) >= 3

detections.sql:
SELECT 
  t.instrument, 
  COUNT(*) as failed_count, 
  SUM(t.amount_usd) as total_usd, 
  COUNT(*) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM transactions WHERE txn_type = 'payment' AND status = 'failed' AND created_at >= date('now', '-60 days')) as failure_rate
FROM 
  transactions t
WHERE 
  t.status = 'failed' AND 
  t.txn_type = 'payment' AND 
  t.created_at >= date('now', '-90 days') AND 
  t.created_at <= date('now', 'start of day')
GROUP BY 
  t.instrument
HAVING 
  SUM(t.amount_usd) > 200000 AND 
  COUNT(*) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM transactions WHERE txn_type = 'payment' AND status = 'failed' AND created_at >= date('now', '-60 days')) > 0.1
